name: Koto Student Housing
address: 9516 University Crescent, Burnaby, British Columbia V5A 1C8
about:
Set on Burnaby Mountain, and just a 5 minute walk to Simon Fraser University, Koto is far from the average student housing campus experience. Its vibrant and design-forward community is where student life unfolds with energy and intention, and where life-long connections are made. With interiors by Ste Marie Studio, Koto channels that unmistakable Scandi sensibility: spaces are welcoming, balanced, and full of charm.
Common areas are thoughtful, inviting, and designed to support both focus and fun. Private and shared residences offer flexibility, while curated amenities inspire community and personal growth —everything you’d expect from modern Burnaby student housing. Koto is so much more than a place to live. It’s where students find their people, their rhythm, and their sense of community.

name: GEC Burnaby Heights
address: 438 Gamma Avenue, Burnaby, British Columbia V5C 0J7
about:
GEC Burnaby Heights offers high-quality student housing in Burnaby, offering beautiful mountain views, convenient transportation, and ample living facilities. A 10-minute drive will take you to Simon Fraser University(SFU) and the Brentwood shopping district. Nearby schools include Confederation Park Elementary, Westridge Elementary, Alpha Secondary, Marlborough Elementary, and Alpha Secondary. Whether for daily commuting or heading to downtown Vancouver, the drive takes approximately 20 minutes.
GEC LIVING is the largest off-campus student apartment in Vancouver, providing high-quality accommodation for over 5000 students annually. We collaborate with multiple renowned institutions and have received recommendations from over 70 organizations. We are dedicated to creating a safe, comfortable, and convenient living environment for international and local students, making the study abroad experience worry-free!

Fully serviced apartments, move-in ready
Full set of furniture and appliances (bed, desk, bedding, kitchenware, fridge, stove, oven, dishwasher, microwave, washer, dryer)
All-inclusive of utilities (water, electricity, heating), no extra bills
High-speed unlimited internet for seamless studying and entertainment
Prime location for easy commuting
GEC LIVING has 5 locations in Vancouver and 1 in Burnaby, all situated in downtown or conveniently accessible areas
Within a 30-minute drive to major campuses in Vancouver, saving time and making commuting more efficient
Safety and peace of mind with attentive service
24/7 emergency assistance, surveillance cameras installed in apartments for added security
Chinese language services provided for smooth communication and stress-free renting
Flexible lease terms to accommodate diverse needs
Minimum lease period of 3 months
Variety of room types available to meet different budgets and lifestyles, welcoming students and families.
